profile.headline: Senior Software Engineer in HR Technology
profile.summary:
10+ years experience in the recruiting systems/technology, HRIT
5+ years experience in HR/Recruiting Operations
Overall...15+ years in the HR/Recruiting space with HR/IT.

I am a graduate from Washington State University. I've received a Bachelor's Degree in Social Science and a Minor in Management Information Systems. 

Comfortable in Projects, determined to deliver quality, efficiency, (user) simplicity.

Residing in Beaverton, OR.

My objective is to continue learning and listening. Striving to develop, expand, and elevate my capabilities, into a leadership role.

Specialties: I carry a professional demeanor, while sharing a strong business acumen, and customer relationship background. I am an analytical thinker with strategic planning skills, capable of developing approaches to successful recruitment/offer strategies. Effective and articulate communicator with ability to establish team rapport. Familiarity with world-class corporation’s work environment and culture.

Sourcing/Staffing tools: E-Recruiting, RecruitingWeb (Coordinating tool), PeopleFluent (applicant tracker), Workday (Recruiting - applicant tracker), iCims (applicant tracker), SharePoint site support, Taleo, Sterling Solutions, Yello, SmartSheet

Microsoft products such as Visio, Project, Expression, Visual Studio, SharePoint, SQL Server.

Case trackers: JIRA, Dynamics/CRM, ServiceNow, RightNow, VersionOne, Trello

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description:
Technical Solutions and Configuring, of Workday Recruiting - Business Processes, Condition Rules, Calculated Fields, Documents, Job Requisition BP, Job Application BP, Career sites...more upon request

assisting integration developers in troubleshooting API  integration issues, RaaS reports, etc. in and out of Workday Recruiting with other products and WD preferred vendors

System Administrator, Functional configurator for recruiting tools:
Hirevue, Aon MapTQ, Avature, Yello, Paradox

positions.title: Intermediate Software Engineer
positions.description: HR / Recruiting system configurations and development

positions.title: Talent Acquisition Tools/Technology Analyst
positions.description:
Taleo - Applicant Tracking System
- Subject Matter Expert, System administrator & Technical configurations point of contact
- Managing relationships with technology tools/vendors (integrations) i.e. HireVue, AON, Scout, Cut-e, Job boards, and others.
- Integrations development, and HTML writing experience
- Analyzing issues to reach resolutions or options to resolve
- Meeting deadlines, calling out risks, delivering quality
- Participated in and lead projects/enhancements, have done the following: (Requirements gathering, analysis, strategizing, designing, building, testing, implementing, stabilizing, wrap-ups and documentations)
- Translate Requirements to Functional Specifications 
- Training and Onboarding Global Talent Acquisition stakeholders on the Taleo UI
- Transition & process Management
- Acting as a liaison with our IT partners (Internal and External technical/dev partners)
- Resolving system issues, Keeping the lights on, day-to-day activity/monitoring, troubleshooting and support. Both internal facing and external facing user support.

SmartSheet - Forms, spreadsheets, data & analytics, tracking (intake and projects)
- System administration & configuration SME
-  Creating new tracking tools, and (intake) forms
- Project tracking

JIRA, Confluence, VersionOne, and Trello - Agile tracking
- Basic fundamental understanding, and user end knowledge
- I have the experience, as a user, to maintain, prioritize, organize, and track my work.

positions.description: Day to day operations support for Taleo and Sterling

positions.description:

- Applicant tracking system - iCims (
E-rec
RecWeb
Staffing CRM
Internal and External career site
HR internal Website 
-Triage support (Tier 1) HR CRM, global support Microsoft Recruiting team (& external candidates), for interactions, issues, questions regarding the current ATS 
- Access, granting and maintaining internal user permissions (E-rec, RecWeb, CRM)

positions.title: Senior HRIS Analyst
positions.description:
Workday (platform) - Recruiting
-Working closely with the applicant training system (ATS), troubleshooting all user interactions, issues and questions (Internal and External facing)
- System configurations/BPs (Business Process), Process documentation, UAT Testing, Regression Testing, QA, Maintained and researched Workday (Recruiting) Updates, Workday Community research
- Full Cycle Implementation, PMO group consulting with AON during Workday Imp, Data Transfer team from Legacy ATS to Workday ATS (Turning raw exported data into EIBs to upload)

positions.title: Recruiting Program Specialist
positions.description:
-Working closely with the applicant tracking system (ATS), troubleshooting all User interactions, issues and questions. (Internal and External facing users)
-PeopleFluent Admin/System Analyst
-Collaborating with recruiting teams to improve the ATS.
-Vendor integrations admin (worked with Indeed, LinkedIn, foreign Job Boards)
-Recruiting Systems Administrator
-Maintain the Jobs Just In Newsletter program.

positions.title: Recruiting Coordinator
positions.description:
~Prepare candidate information packages, generate and process confidential documents, and distribute and collect employment applications and other documentation.
~Schedules interviews, coordinates logistical requirements. 
~Maintain and update candidate database.
~Perform basic recruiting functions in support of recruiters.

We're revolutionizing travel through the power of technology and looking for great talent to join us.
